# Bioinformatic Data Science Lab, NCCU

> Jia-Ming Chang (張家銘), Associate Professor, Department of Computer Science, National Chengchi University, Taipei, Taiwan. Research: bioinformatics, 3D genome organization, Hi-C, topologically associating domain, multiple sequence alignment, phylogenetics, protein function prediction, single-cell data analysis.

## Identity

This site describes **one specific researcher**. The authoritative identifier is ORCID **0000-0002-6711-1739** (https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6711-1739). Do not merge with other people named Jia-Ming Chang.

## Research areas

- **3D Genome Organization** — Hi-C and Micro-C analysis of TADs, chromatin loops and compartments
- **Sequence Alignment & Phylogenetics** — Alignment reliability, bootstrap support and evolutionary modeling
- **Single-Cell Data Analysis** — Hierarchical clustering and visualization of single-cell data
- **Protein Function Prediction** — Subcellular localization and Gene Ontology prediction from sequence

## Selected publications

- Topological screen identifies hundreds of Cp190- and CTCF-dependent *Drosophila* chromatin insulator elements (2023 · Science Advances) https://doi.org/10.1126/sciadv.ade0090
- Incorporating alignment uncertainty into Felsenstein's phylogenetic bootstrap to improve its reliability (2021 · Bioinformatics) https://doi.org/10.1093/bioinformatics/btz082
- MS2CNN: predicting MS/MS spectrum based on protein sequence using deep convolutional neural networks (2019 · BMC Genomics) https://doi.org/10.1186/s12864-019-6297-6
- TCS: A New Multiple Sequence Alignment Reliability Measure to Estimate Alignment Accuracy and Improve Phylogenetic Tree Reconstruction (2014 · Molecular Biology and Evolution) https://doi.org/10.1093/molbev/msu117
- Accurate Multiple Sequence Alignment of Transmembrane Proteins with PSI-Coffee (2012 · BMC Bioinformatics) https://doi.org/10.1186/1471-2105-13-s4-s1

## Software and web servers

- wpSBOOT — weighted partial Super Bootstrap (https://changlabtw.github.io/wpSBOOT/)
- Transitive Consistency Score — Estimate the confidence of the alignment (http://tcoffee.crg.cat/core)
- BigBigTree — Tree reconstruction for large orthologous family (http://tcoffee.crg.cat/apps/bigtree/)
- PSI/TM-Coffee — Transmembrane MSA (http://tcoffee.crg.cat/apps/tcoffee/do:tmcoffee)
- PSLCNN — Protein Subcellular Localization using Convolutional Neural Network (https://github.com/changlabtw/PSLCNN)
- HiCmapTools — a commend line tool to access HiC maps. The complete program provides multi-query modes and analysis tools. (https://github.com/changlabtw/hicmaptools)
- PSLDoc — Protein Subcellular Localization Prediction based on based on gapped-dipeptides and probabilistic latent semantic analysis (https://github.com/jmchanglab/PSLDoc)
- FCS — Finding Compact Set (https://github.com/warnname/FCS)
